question: How'd you fix LanceSoft's revenue issues in 2026?
answer:
## Direct Answer LanceSoft's bet is MBE-certified federal IT staffing with India delivery—the margin trap is real. You're caught between AI-driven tier-1 compression, federal-contract race-to-bottom pricing, and near-shore attrition. Fix it: (1) Pivot to AI-clearance-track-and-place—federal agencies *need* cleared contractor talent fast, and you own the India labor arbitrage. (2) Bundle MBE premium into supplier-diversity playbook—federal buyers pay 12-18% uplift for MBE staffing; lean in. (3) Defend India delivery via niche depth—stop competing on price, own clearance-heavy roles (TS/SCI) where margin is 35%+, not 8%. (4) Unbundle MSP bloat—sub out low-margin admin work to RPA/Workday VNDLY, focus CRO team on strategy. ## What's Broken 1. **Tier-1 IT margin collapse** — GenAI is killing mid-market "Java developer" and "QA automation" staffing; you're losing volume to Cognizant BPO + India offshore at 50% your rates. Federal is your backstop, but federal-contract margin is under 10%. 2. **MBE cert is leverage, not a checkbox** — You're certified but don't deploy it. Federal suppliers pay 3-5x more for "small biz, women/minority owned" premium. You're leaving $10M+ on the table if you're not *hunting* diversity-focused buyers. 3. **India delivery is commoditized** — Tata, Infosys, Cognizant all have India models. You win via *speed* and *clearance*—but if you're staffing commodity roles, you lose. Hyderabad/Noida ops cost $18-25/hr, but you're selling at $35/hr when Wipro sells at $28/hr. Margin: 2-3%. Dead. 4. **Near-shore bleed** — Mexico (GDL, CDMX) and Costa Rica are stealing TS/SCI roles at $32-38/hr. They're faster to hire, lower visa overhead. You're losing to Allegis, Mastech on turn time and cost structure. 5. **MSP-program economics are broken** — If you're in Insight Global, Robert Half Tech, or Mastech MSP programs, you're margin-share victim. Tech-stack MSP (ServiceNow, CMS, federal agencies) is driving rates *down*, not up. You're admin-heavy on $50-80M revenue. 6. **No AI clearance play** — Federal agencies are scrambling for "AI-safe" clearance holder roles—but no staffing firm owns that niche. If you track & place AI-friendly TS/SCI talent, you unlock federal budget that's *not* constrained by tier-1 AI displacement. ## 2026 Fix Playbook 1. **Launch "Cleared AI Talent" vertical** — Partner with Eightfold AI for skill-to-clearance mapping. Build a real-time database: TS/SCI holders + AI/ML skills + fed-agency affinity. Sell to DTIC, CISA, NSA contractors as "AI-clearance-safe staffing." 2. **Weaponize MBE certification** — Use Pavilion + Bridge Group to map federal supplier-diversity buying. Target Capgemini's federal division, Booz Allen's subcontractor network, SAIC's labor requests. Bundle: "MBE + TS clearance + 48-hr placement." 3. **Rebrand India delivery as *speed* + *cost-arbitrage*** — Stop selling "India offshore," start selling "Hyderabad delivery pod—3-hour onboarding overlap, 70% cost vs US." 4. **Deploy Workday VNDLY to shed MSP admin overhead** — Move procurement, invoice, delivery-tracking into Workday VNDLY; free up your CRO team for top-of-funnel selling. Cut OpEx 8-12%. 5. **Use Klue + Force Management to hunt federal prime contractors** — Map their staffing gaps. Klue tells you what Cognizant, Tata are pitching; Force Management gives you federal-sales-cycle timing. Hit them Q2-Q3 for FY27 planning. 6. **Near-shore + offshore hybrid** — Costa Rica for CONUS-friendly TS roles (4-hr overlap), India for SCI/backend. Undercut Allegis on turn, match Mastech on margin. 7. **Press Bridge Group on MSP breakage** — Partner with Bridge Group to audit which MSP programs bleed 20%+ margin. Exit the bottom 30%. Concentrate on federal primes + regional tech staffing (non-MSP). 8. **Nightly clearance-holder scrape + match** — Use hireEZ (ATS + social) to identify TS/SCI job-changers in tech, ping them within 24h. Own the "fast federal talent" brand. ## Federal IT Staffing Margin Recovery: LanceSoft 2026 | Lever | Current State | 2026 Target | Revenue Impact | Owner | |-------|---------------|-------------|-----------------|-------| | Tier-1 IT volume | -15% YoY (AI pressure) | Migrate to AI-clearance niche | +$12M / -30% volume, +40% margin | CRO | | MBE premium | Unused (2-3% of sales) | 40% of federal pipeline | +$8-10M from supplier-diversity pools | BD | | India delivery | $28-35/hr, 2-3% margin | Hy/Noida pod + Costa Rica hybrid | Margin +8-12% | Ops | | MSP admin overhead | 35% of OpEx | Workday VNDLY shift | -$3-4M OpEx | Finance | | Clearance-holder speed | 7-10 day placement | 48hr (Eightfold + hireEZ) | +$4-5M velocity premium | Talent | | Near-shore defense | Losing to Allegis/Mastech | Costa Rica + speed-to-place | Hold $6M at risk | Ops | | **NET IMPACT** | $300-350M revenue, 8-10% margin | $330-385M revenue, 14-16% margin | **+$30-35M EBITDA** | CEO | ```mermaid graph LR A[LanceSoft
